concept.name: ROC curve
concept.definition: A threshold curve plotting true-positive rate against false-positive rate for a binary score.
concept.intuition: It summarizes one aspect of prediction error or decision quality in a number or curve.
concept.mechanics: Sort distinct score thresholds, classify observations at each threshold, and plot recall against one minus specificity.
concept.failure_modes: Class imbalance, threshold choice, unequal error costs, outliers, and dependence can make the summary inappropriate or unstable.
concept.misconceptions: No single metric captures economic utility, turnover, risk, calibration, and trading costs at once.
concept.example: Lowering a threshold raises TPR from 0.60 to 0.80 while FPR rises from 0.10 to 0.25, adding a point to the ROC curve.
